work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Issue #93 remains active through the frozen collection cutoff.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind discovery of committed Workflow Arena aggregate reports and methodology. W1 admitted five workflow arms sharing the source-reported primary model, high reasoning setting, eight-task diagnostic panel, three runs per task, and blinded-judge aggregation. MatrixSpec arms were not included because the source documents a different operator interaction protocol and retrospective representative-arm selection.
discovery_pass.benchmark_surface: eight frozen repository-level coding tasks; five admitted Codex CLI workflow arms; three independent candidate runs per task/arm

source_known_dimensions: three independent candidate runs per task and arm
candidate network and web search disabled
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact Codex CLI build/version across all historical campaigns
aggregate matrix does not carry each task baseline commit identifier
campaign-recorded timing semantics are not fully uniform across historical campaigns
workflow arms differ by injected capability and some use Ground Truth operator interaction
full source commits for Grill Me, OpenSpec, and Ponytail are exposed only as short prefixes in the public methodology

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The public methodology documents a different artifact-audit operator protocol and retrospective representative-arm selection; W1 does not silently fold those arms into this five-arm comparison group.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: Workflow Arena author interpretations and quality/cost winner language
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves the reported raw panel metrics and source limitations without adopting rankings, mechanism claims, or general-performance conclusions.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: component-level causal effects inside Superpowers or other workflow packs
non_admission_dispositions.reason: The core panel compares bundled workflow treatments and is not a component-randomized experiment.
